scripts.contract:generate: cd .. && go run ./internal/contracts/externals/generate -repository . -provider externals -manifest externals/contract/manifest.json -bindings externals/contract/bindings.json -tsconfig externals/tsconfig.json -gostdlib-manifest gostdlib/contract/manifest.json -goos linux -goarch amd64 -tags noasm -backend node -integer number -concurrency cooperative
scripts.contract:check: cd .. && go run ./internal/contracts/externals/generate -repository . -provider externals -manifest externals/contract/manifest.json -bindings externals/contract/bindings.json -tsconfig externals/tsconfig.json -gostdlib-manifest gostdlib/contract/manifest.json -goos linux -goarch amd64 -tags noasm -backend node -integer number -concurrency cooperative -check
scripts.check: npm run contract:check && npm run build && npm run assemble:local && node --test dist/test/**/*.test.js
